conclusion.recommendation: Do not promote flat-fill as the required Gallery performance repair
conclusion.reason: Gallery pair1 increased1.855% and pair2 decreased0.885%; the two-trial mean increased0.478%. This is no reliable Gallery benefit. conclusion.styleObservation: Both candidates recorded5 RecalcStyle events versus6 for controls, but that count reduction did not produce a reliable Gallery wall-time improvement. This is an observation, not exclusive CPU attribution or a proven mechanism.

limits: Two samples per source are a bounded diagnostic, not a performance distribution.
